Design, develop, and deliver key post-market process analytics, tools, and insights across Philips to ensure ongoing Patient Safety and Quality.

  1. Accountable for leading and redefining a Philips Post Market Surveillance (PMS) Process reporting framework, establishing a single source of truth (data management and collection), and leading continuous improvement projects based on stakeholder feedback.

St. Luke's is proud of the skills, experience and compassion of its employees. The employees of St. Luke's are our most valuable asset! Individually and together, our employees are dedicated to satisfying the mission of our organization which is an unwavering commitment to excellence as we care for the sick and injured; educate physicians, nurses and other health care providers; and improve access to care in the communities we serve, regardless of a patient's ability to pay for health care.
The Advanced Practitioner is responsible for providing healthcare services to patients under the supervision of, and/or in collaboration with, the attending physician. In addition, the AP will participate in patient satisfaction, quality, and performance improvement initiatives.
CRITICAL CARE ADVANCED PRACTITIONERS AT ST. LUKE'S:
As our health network expands, our CCAP team continues to grow creating multifaceted opportunities within our department and the Network. We have 8 Campuses that provide Critical Care Services to our communities and allow for a diverse Critical Care Population and endless growth opportunities. As a member of the Critical Care Team, you are highly respected, and vital to St. Luke’s mission of providing affordable, high-quality care. As an Advanced Practitioner Provider, you will have the opportunity to practice medicine to your fullest potential in a multidisciplinary, collaborative model with excellent team dynamics.

  • Works in conjunction with critical care physicians and staff to care for medical, surgical and critical care patients as requested.
  • Performs therapeutic and diagnostic procedures as directed by the supervising physician. (See credentials list).
  • Participates in performance improvement activities, meetings, educational projects, and research projects while supporting the philosophy and strategic plan of the department.
  • Demonstrates ability to develop effective working relationships within the hospital and St. Luke's University Health Network.
  • Demonstrates competency in the assessment, range of treatment, knowledge of growth and development and communication appropriate to the age of the patient treated.

  • Allentown Campus- 15 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
  • Anderson Campus-16 bed mixed Medical/Surgical/Trauma ICU
  • Bethlehem Campus (Providers rotate through all ICU’s - Cardiac Medical/Surgical ICU 12 bed; Neuro ICU variable bed; Surgical/Trauma ICU variable beds)
  • Carbon Campus- 12 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
  • GSL Campus-10 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
  • Monroe Campus-12 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
  • Upper Bucks Campus-10 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
  • Warren Campus-12 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU

  • Night/Night Weekend ONLY positions available
  • 13 hour shifts (6a-7p and 6p-7a)
  • 18 shifts in a 6-week block.
  • No more than 50% nights and 50% weekends
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Competent in the assessment, treatment, counseling, and education of the patient, and their families, being provided medical services.
  • Competency in evaluating patients and performing physical examinations including obtaining, studying, and updating medical histories.
  • Demonstrates ability to determine abnormal conditions by administering or ordering diagnostic tests, such as radiologic and laboratory studies, and then accurately interpreting test results.
  • Evaluates, develops, and implements appropriate patient management and treatment plans, based on assessment of needs
  • Coordinates and communicates patient care effectively with other healthcare professionals and institutions to meet patient’s healthcare needs.
  • Provides high quality health care, based on best practice and/or evidenced based medicine.
  • Performs therapeutic and diagnostic procedures, as appropriate, and aligned with granted clinical privileges
  • As requested, conduct virtual care services, described as live and interactive clinical assessments, diagnosis, and treatment of patients via St. Luke’s virtual care platform, assisting in care coordination and/or escalation of care, as appropriate
  • Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies. Maintains required continuing medical education
  • Participates in the research, development, implementation, and tracking of clinical management guidelines.
  • Participates in the teaching of multidisciplinary students (nursing, nurse practitioner, pharmacy, physician assistant, medical, etc.) and physician residents & fellows, ensuring a positive educational environment.
  • Participates in AP student clinical rotation preceptorship, when assigned

  • Demonstrates financial responsibility and accountability through the effective and efficient use of resources in daily procedures, processes and practices.
  • Develops care and dispositions plans in conjunction with the case management team.

  • Two years of experience desired, preferably in critical care, trauma, and/or acute care setting. New grads are encouraged to apply!

Our employed providers benefit from a dedicated leadership structure, a professional organization, and a culture that puts patient care at the center. With an established department of advanced practice that has a dedicated leadership structure, and with room for advancement and growth within the Network.

title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst
description:
The Credit Risk Squad is part of the 2nd line of Defense, responsible for managing and overseeing the credit risk function of our organization by providing independent oversight and challenge to the first line of defense. As a second line Credit Risk team, we are responsible for creating Expected Credit Losses (ECL) models that are used to calculate loss allowances, making sure the company’s credit risk is managed correctly and efficiently, participating end-to-end in the model development process, including, implementation,monitoring, ensuring operational quality of the data and supporting Finance accounting teams.

About the Role:

As a Senior Credit Risk Analyst within our Credit Risk Squad (part of the 2nd Line of Defense), you will play a crucial role in overseeing and challenging the first line of defense in managing credit risk. Your primary focus will be on analyzing the health and performance of our credit portfolio, particularly within the retail market portfolios, including credit cards and personal loans. You will contribute significantly to ensuring the company’s credit risk is managed effectively, with a strong emphasis on the universe of credit provisions.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Analyzing and monitoring risk parameter models (PD, LGD, EAD) relevant to our retail portfolios, ensuring they align with regulations like IFRS9. While not necessarily developing these models, you will be instrumental in measuring their performance through activities such as backtesting to assess their quality.
  • Performing in-depth analysis of credit risk exposure and its implications for expected credit losses (ECL) and loss allowances. This will involve understanding how changes in the credit portfolio impact our provisions.
  • Participating in monthly accounting closing activities, contributing to the creation of reports on loss allowance movements.
  • Actively contributing to the enhancement of our controls environment within credit risk management. This is crucial for ensuring compliance with regulations such as SOX.
  • Liaising with Internal and External Audit teams during model validation processes, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and SOX compliance in our operational processes.
  • Maintaining a strong understanding of relevant local and international regulations concerning provisions and credit risk management, including a surface-level understanding of standards like Bacen 4966 and IFRS9.
  • Leveraging your analytical and problem-solving skills to manipulate and learn from data related to the credit portfolio.
  • This role requires a strong analytical background, a keen understanding of credit risk principles, and the ability to contribute to a robust and compliant credit risk management framework. Your work will directly impact the accuracy of our financial reporting and the overall stability of our credit operations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Math, Statistics, Physics or related fields
  • Analytical, problem solving and passionate to manipulate data in order to learn from it
  • Great coding skills (SQL, Python, Scala or other similar programming languages)
  • Knowledge and experience in local and international regulations regarding provisions and credit risk management
  • Adaptability to dynamic way of working/short term deliverables

Preferred qualifications

  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • Experience with SOX controls within risk management environment
  • Experience in developing or analyzing outputs of Expected Credit Loss models/PD/EAD/LGD

title: Strategy & Consulting Partner
description:
Cache Ventures is dedicated to building, advising, and investing in high-growth companies across multiple industries. Our mission is to create and scale businesses that drive impact, innovation, and long-term value. Our growth strategy is powered by a combination of proprietary scaling frameworks, operational excellence, and an unwavering commitment to success.
We've helped countless startups accelerate growth, refine their business strategies, and scale to new heights. Now, we're expanding our efforts by bringing in top-tier talent to lead and execute our strategic consulting initiatives.
The Role
The Strategy & Consulting Partner will be a pivotal player in scaling our consulting frameworks and advisory services. This role is designed for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, possesses deep business acumen, and enjoys guiding companies through complex challenges. Specifically, this role will involve:

  • Presenting strategic business frameworks to portfolio companies and external clients
  • Acting as the lead facilitator for high-impact workshops focused on business acceleration
  • Reviewing business cases, identifying bottlenecks, and crafting actionable solutions to drive growth
  • Providing 1-on-1 consulting to businesses, guiding them through tailored strategic roadmaps
  • Building and optimizing the systems necessary to scale our advisory and consulting services
  • Maintaining ongoing relationships with clients and portfolio companies, ensuring continued success and engagement
Why This Role Matters
This role offers a unique opportunity to work directly with ambitious entrepreneurs, high-growth startups, and emerging businesses. As part of Cache Ventures, you'll play a critical role in shaping the future of companies poised for major expansion.
By joining our team, you'll:
  • Gain unparalleled exposure to diverse industries, business models, and scaling challenges
  • Build a powerful network of high-level operators and entrepreneurs
  • Be instrumental in designing and executing frameworks that help companies reach their full potential
  • Have a direct impact on company growth trajectories through strategic execution

Responsibilities

External
  • Lead strategic consulting sessions with portfolio companies and high-growth businesses
  • Develop and deliver insightful presentations on business strategy, market positioning, and scalability
  • Facilitate roundtable discussions and live problem-solving exercises with business owners
  • Evaluate client businesses and craft tailored solutions to accelerate their growth
  • Establish long-term relationships with clients, acting as their strategic partner in success

Internal
  • Work with Cache Ventures' leadership team to refine and iterate on business strategy frameworks
  • Build a scalable model for consulting and advisory services, including operational playbooks and SOPs
  • Train and mentor subject matter experts to expand the reach of our consulting programs
  • Develop performance tracking mechanisms to measure the effectiveness of strategic engagements
  • Optimize internal documentation, business workflows, and consulting frameworks to ensure consistency and excellence
Results & Impact
  • Deliver high-impact workshops and consulting sessions with actionable takeaways
  • Ensure an exceptional client experience, maintaining high engagement and satisfaction scores
  • Track and optimize client business growth, measuring revenue impact and strategic milestones
  • Build and lead a scalable consulting infrastructure that supports Cache Ventures' long-term vision

Requirements
  • Elite Business Leadership: You've mastered the art of business, whether through a top-tier MBA and consulting background, successfully scaling and exiting a $15M+ revenue company, or leading operational value creation in private equity
  • Startup Agility: You thrive in fast-paced, startup-like environments where adaptability and quick decision making are essential
  • Exceptional Communication: You captivate audiences, command rooms with confidence, and know how to engage business owners through powerful storytelling and compelling insights
  • Master Influencer: You're skilled at navigating objections, winning buy-in, and inspiring action, turning skeptics into believers
  • Emotional Intelligence & Relationship Building: You don't just network, you build deep, meaningful relationships that foster long-term success
  • Sharp Business Acumen: With your expertise, you can educate and elevate others, empowering them to make smarter business decisions
  • Creative Problem Solver: You see the big picture, break down complex challenges, and find innovative solutions with speed and precision
  • Adaptability & Leadership: You're comfortable in both leadership and support roles, adjusting seamlessly to shifting priorities and ambiguous situations
  • Integrity & Excellence: You take pride in delivering results with efficiency, dedication, and a relentless commitment to excellence
  • Self-Driven & Detail-Oriented: You don't wait for direction, you take initiative, ensuring every detail is accounted for and every goal is met

Benefits
  • Competitive salary and performance bonuses
  • Unlimited PTO policy and company-wide holidays
  • Professional development budget for continued learning
  • Remote first with travel requirements for workshops and consulting engagements
  • Access to exclusive industry events, networking opportunities, and leadership summits
Why Join Cache Ventures?
At Cache Ventures, we believe in empowering leaders, driving strategic excellence, and making a tangible impact on the companies we work with. If you're passionate about helping businesses scale, thrive in high-growth environments, and want to be part of a dynamic team shaping the future of entrepreneurship, we want to hear from you.
Let's build something great together.

Somos muitos e únicos, cada um trabalhando para dar vida ao nosso propósito.

Além disso, há experiências que só a C&A pode oferecer: ambiente leve, informal e divertido; valores e compromissos sociais; desenvolvimento profissional no varejo; e conexão com uma marca de renome.

Main responsibilities

Posição estratégica, responsável por elaborar e evoluir a plataforma de dados da empresa: Data Warehouse, Datalake e camada de visualização. É responsável por implementar soluções de dados escaláveis e eficientes em custo.

Tem forte interação com demais líderes técnicos e de negócios para entendimento das necessidades e construção da soluções, envolvendo: ingestão e tratamento de dados, criação de ambientes analíticos, preparação de dados para Machine Learning , construção de data marts , integrações.

Lidera o time de engenheiros de dados, garantindo releases de qualidade e boas práticas para desenvolvimento do código. Implementa processos de observability e CI/CD.

  • Participar ativamente na entrega dos dados de ponta a ponta: entendimento do problema a ser resolvido, organização em acionáveis e sincronização com stakeholders e times;
  • Construir roadmap de evolução da plataforma de dados incluindo milestones e métricas de acompanhamento
  • Projetar arquiteturas de dados eficientes, garantindo alta disponibilidade e segurança para processamento em tempo real e batch. Capacidade para dados estruturados e não estruturados
  • Influenciar decisões estratégicas, balanceando em custo, escalabilidade e performance das soluções de dados.
  • Implementar e otimizar modelos de dados para suportar aplicações de machine learning e consumo por aplicações críticas.
  • Automatizar a infraestrutura de dados utilizando Infrastructure as Code (IaC) .
  • Monitorar a confiabilidade dos pipelines, prevenindo falhas e garantindo SLAs com alto nível de observabilidade.
  • Liderar revisões pós-mortem , criando planos de ação para melhoria contínua da plataforma de dados.
  • Mentorar e disseminar boas práticas dentro dos times de engenharia.
  • Promover o desenvolvimento técnico e de pessoas da equipe.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação em exatas: Ciência da Computação, Física, Matemática, Estatística;
  • + 4 anos com experiência gerencial;
  • Gestão de Data Lake (AWS, GCP) e Data Warehouse (Teradata, Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks);
  • Conhecimento em: arquitetura de dados, modelagem de dados, orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Argo, Control-M);
  • Conhecimento avançado em: serviço de dados (batch, online, real-time, etc.); construção e armazenamento de dados, processos de ETL/ELT;
  • Experiência em liderança técnica de projetos de times de Engenharia de dados;
  • Experiência em DevOps (infra as a code, micro serviços, CI/CD, git, etc).

Additional information

O que oferecemos?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, incluindo equipamentos para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Com dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, a empresa investe 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento.

Em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a alemã Putzmeister, formando o maior líder mundial em equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a presença do Grupo Sany começou em 2007, inicialmente como importador, consolidando-se em 2011 com investimentos de US$ 200 milhões e a inauguração de uma unidade de montagem em São José dos Campos. Em 2012, recebeu a certificação ISO 9001:2008. A partir de 2013, passou a montar guindastes RT e rolos compactadores na mesma unidade. Em 2017, inaugurou instalações em Jacareí/SP. A rede de distribuidores e filiais garante atendimento em todo o país.

description:

Join to apply for the Analista Planejamento São Paulo SP role at Afonso França Engenharia

A AFONSO FRANÇA ENGENHARIA possui décadas de expertise no cenário da construção civil, com um histórico impressionante de centenas de obras realizadas em todo o território nacional.
Nosso compromisso com a excelência se reflete em diversos setores como Industrial, Papel e Celulose, Saúde, Data Centers e Corporativo.
Orgulhamo-nos de ocupar a 13ª posição no ranking das 500 Maiores Construtoras do Brasil, conforme publicado pela renomada Revista O Empreiteiro em 2023.
Acreditamos que o aperfeiçoamento contínuo através das pessoas é fundamental para o nosso sucesso.
Nossa visão vai além da construção de edifícios; buscamos construir parcerias sólidas e rigorosas.
Estamos prontos para enfrentar novos desafios e continuar superando as expectativas.
Juntos, podemos construir um futuro melhor! Conheça os requisitos para fazer parte desta equipe:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver com base nas informações coletadas, cronogramas detalhados da obra, levando em consideração as sequências de atividades, os prazos estabelecidos e os recursos disponíveis. Utilizando software de gerenciamento de projetos para criar e atualizar os cronogramas conforme necessário;
  • Auxiliar na análise dos recursos necessários para a execução do projeto, como mão de obra, equipamentos e materiais. Realizando estudos de viabilidade para avaliar a viabilidade técnica do projeto;
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o cronograma de suprimentos;
  • Realizar e coordenar as reuniões semanais com equipe da obra e fornecedores;
  • Monitorar durante a execução da obra, o progresso das atividades em relação ao cronograma planejado. Registrando informações atualizadas sobre o andamento da obra, identificando desvios em relação ao plano e fornecendo relatórios regulares à equipe de gerenciamento do projeto (programação trissemanal de trabalho – PST’s);
  • Auxiliar na identificação e avaliação dos riscos associados ao projeto, colaborando com a equipe para desenvolver estratégias de mitigação de riscos e planos de contingência, ajudando a minimizar possíveis atrasos ou impactos negativos na obra;
  • Fazer atualização da produtividade e da meta de produção, acompanhar da Curva S e Curva de Tendência;
  • Analisar os cronogramas das obras, gerando e analisando Linhas de Balanço e Diagrama de Tempo-Caminho, análise de obras simultâneas e utilização de ferramentas de gestão de prazo.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Domínio em Excel;
  • Domínio em Project;
  • Desejável domínio em Power BI (é um diferencial);

O Expert Migration Brazil oferece treinamentos a enfermeiros bacharelados para prepará-los ao reconhecimento da profissão na Alemanha.

- Suporte na validação do diploma de enfermagem e emissão de licença profissional;

title: Software Engineer (Trust & Safety Team)
description:
The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a software engineer to join the Trust and Safety Product team. As a software engineer, you will be responsible for building features to keep our communities safe from abuse, harassment, vandalism, and harmful or illicit content. In this role, you will work in a fully-remote, geographically-distributed environment, where we value teamwork and a consensus-oriented approach. You will be writing open source code for collaborative experiences supporting over a billion users at a place that believes we're all more successful when everyone has a good work-life balance.

The Trust and Safety Product team is an interdisciplinary product team developing technology that helps counteract efforts to harm civil discourse on our platforms, the integrity of the content, or other users of our projects. We are seeking a software engineer to join us in this effort to protect our users and our projects.

Currently, we are working on a broad set of tools related to user privacy and protection. Your daily work will include contributing new patches or pull requests for existing features, estimating new work, participating in code reviews, collaborating with a designer, or helping a volunteer engineer get their code shaped up. Because of the sensitive nature of the tools we build, we interact with database administrators, security engineers, and our legal team on a regular basis. Our work goes beyond regular product development into topics such as privacy, security, abuse mitigation, content moderation and legal compliance.

The team is fully staffed with a Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Product Designer, Research Analyst, Data Analyst, Community Liaison, Test Engineers, and several Software Engineers.

Our world is vast and can be complicated, so we consider communication, enthusiasm, and eagerness to learn as important as certificates or degrees.

Responsibilities

  • Developing, testing, and deploying new features, improvements and upgrades to various systems and tools used by administrators and staff.
  • Documenting your contributions to our codebase in our technical documentation and our features’ documentation.
  • Contributing to projects that require handling sensitive data and private information, complying with privacy and security regulations.
  • Providing support in abuse investigations on our platform, helping identify sources and causes of incidents, and proposing ideas to mitigate their impact.
  • Developing expertise in the Trust and Safety area, which includes, security, privacy, abuse mitigation, content moderation and legal compliance.
  • Extending the capabilities of the MediaWiki stack to serve diverse community needs by incorporating possibilities that are offered by new tooling or technical advances.
  • Working across teams to proactively reduce technical debt by refactoring code, updating testing frameworks, and reviewing code from other engineers.

Skills and experience

  • 3+ years of related professional or volunteering experience in software engineering roles, including frontend and backend development, with an emphasis on backend.
  • Experience converting design mockups into functional components, incorporating performance and accessibility into the features using well-documented and readable code.
  • Focused software engineering: writing unit and integration tests, proactively addressing security and code review feedback, and thoughtfully balancing tradeoffs.
  • Strong written communication skills as our collaboration largely happens online, on chats, wikis, documents and tickets.

Qualities that are important to us

  • The desire to make meaningful contributions to knowledge equity, free culture, and open access.
  • An emphasis on communicating clearly in both synchronous and asynchronous channels.
  • The willingness to participate in technical discussions, proposing solutions to technical challenges, participating in code reviews and receiving feedback.
  • An eagerness and curiosity to solve technical problems, trying things out and investigating issues, and supporting the work of others.
  • The skill to effectively work with documentation, writing clearly and concisely, and navigating existing documentation in search for answers.
  • A sensitivity for the problems we are solving, empathy for our users, and the tact to handle the content and information we process.

Additionally, we’d love it if you have this

  • Experience with MediaWiki development or as a contributor to Wikimedia projects.
  • Experience with legacy codebases and/or experience in free/open source software development experience.
  • Experience with online community moderation, vandalism prevention and other Trust and Safety concepts and practices.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$ 88,975 to US$ 139,056 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

description:

Join to apply for the Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology - from the kernel through userspace. Apply here if you are an exceptional Go, Rust, or C/C++ software engineer and want to work on next-generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage.
Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.
Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.
RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.
Docker images are easy to make and publish on Docker Hub and other registries, but the quality, consistency and security maintenance of those images is broadly very poor. Canonical is in a good position to publish a portfolio of outstanding Docker images. Our Rockcraft team is designing and implementing an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
LXD is a modern system container and virtual machine manager that is widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI.
Members of the Kubernetes product team build MicroK8s for on-rails K8s, and Charmed Kubernetes for more sophisticated integration. We work on K8s itself and on the operations tooling around it.
The OpenStack team deliver Charmed OpenStack, OVN / OVS and Ceph. This work brings cloud platform technologies to large-scale computing environments.
These teams hire system level C/C++, Golang, Rust and Python developers to work on security-critical, performance-critical and mission-critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management. Our teams are motivated to have a meaningful impact on modern cloud computing technologies.
Location : we have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone.
What you will focus on

  • Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach
  • Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise
  • Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth
  • Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • You have worked on open source virt or container tech
  • You have experience working in the kernel or very low level system
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills We Value
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Mandrilhador I (OFSE) - Macaé, RJ
description:
Você gostaria de ter a oportunidade de desenvolver sua carreira em uma empresa global de energia?

Quer trabalhar com um time apaixonado pelo que faz?

Faça parceria com os melhores!

Líder no setor de serviços de campos petrolíferos. A Baker Hughes oferece oportunidades para pessoas qualificadas que desejam crescer em nossa organização de alto desempenho. Nossas tecnologias líderes e nossa capacidade de aplicá-las com segurança e criar valor de forma eficaz para nossos clientes e acionistas.

Como Mandrilhador I, você será responsável por:

TAREFAS DIÁRIAS

  • Realizar reunião de pré-trabalho, preenchendo formulário e check list, fazendo a leitura dos procedimentos e documentos para realização da operação, com o objetivo de identificar se os itens necessários para a execução da atividade estão disponíveis.
  • Realizar movimentação de peça para a máquina, utilizando ponte rolante, talha, cintas, olhais, correntes e manilhas, seguindo os procedimentos de segurança e isolando a área.
  • Preparar peça na máquina - fixar a peça na mesa da mandrilhadora de acordo com as informações fornecidas pela Engenharia Industrial (Doc.: folha de preparação), garantindo que a peça não se mova durante a operação de usinagem.
  • Realizar o isolamento da área, seguindo os procedimentos de segurança.
  • Realizar captura dos pontos zeros inserindo a captura dos pontos zeros conforme informado pela Engenharia industrial, utilizando relógios apalpadores, comparadores ou cabeça Probe. Essa atividade é feita para garantir que as coordenadas do programa CNC estejam de acordo com o posicionamento geométrico da peça.
  • Realizar zeramento de ferramentas - encostar a ferramenta na peça ou com bloco padrão entre a peça e a ferramenta para realizar o zeramento. Inserir os valores na máquina de forma manual com o objetivo de determinar o ponto de início (ponto zero) da ferramenta com relação a peça, para realizar a usinagem.
  • Realizar operação de usinagem em mandrilhadoras Wotans - a usinagem das peças é feita conforme sequência pré-definida no programa CNC. Serão realizadas operações de fresamento, furação, rosqueamento e usinagem de perfis internos com ferramentas especiais, transformando a matéria prima nas dimensões especificadas no projeto do cliente.
  • Realizar inspeções das medidas usinadas fazendo uso de instrumentos de medição como: paquímetro, micrômetro, súbito, tubular, ball-gage, relógios entre outros, assegurando que não sejam fabricadas peças com dimensões que estejam fora da especificação no projeto do cliente.
  • Realizar usinagem utilizando cabeçotes angulares - deve-se fixar cabeçote angular na máquina, inclinando de acordo com as determinações da Engenharia Industrial, para realizar operações em ângulos, graus, em diâmetros internos de difícil acesso.

Para ter sucesso nessa função, você precisa:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Curso de Fresador CNC
  • Experiência prévia na função
  • Controle dimensional
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnicos
  • Conhecimentos de Métodos e Processos de Usinagem
  • Identificar e registrar findings de segurança
  • Identificar e sugerir melhorias do processo
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos
  • Conhecimentos em Tolerâncias Geométricas (GD&T)

Características desejadas:

  • Manuseio e transporte de peças com ponte rolante
  • Conhecimentos básicos nos softwares: Oracle, Epims, Gensuite, Manusis
  • Conhecimento em ferramental e consumíveis para os processos produtivos existentes
  • Treinamento LEAN Básico
  • Programação CNC
  • Cursos na área de Metalurgia.
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas
  • Conhecimento de Produto de Óleo e Gás.
  • Inglês intermediário

Trabalhe de uma forma que funcione para você

Reconhecemos que todos são diferentes e que a maneira pela qual as pessoas querem trabalhar e dar o melhor de si também é diferente para cada pessoa.

Trabalhando conosco

Nosso pessoal está no centro do que fazemos na Baker Hughes. Sabemos que somos melhores quando todo o nosso pessoal está desenvolvido, engajado e capaz de trabalhar com toda a sua autenticidade. Investimos na saúde e no bem-estar de nossa força de trabalho, treinamos e recompensamos talentos e desenvolvemos líderes em todos os níveis para extrair o melhor de cada um.

Trabalhando para você

Nossas invenções revolucionaram a energia por mais de um século. Mas, para continuar amanhã, sabemos que temos que ultrapassar os limites hoje. Priorizamos recompensar aqueles que abraçam a mudança com um pacote que reflete o quanto valorizamos sua contribuição. Junte-se a nós e você pode esperar:

  • Políticas contemporâneas de equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal e atividades de bem-estar
  • Opções abrangentes de assistência médica privada
  • Rede de segurança de seguros de vida e programas de invalidez
  • Programas financeiros personalizados
  • Benefícios adicionais eleitos ou voluntários

Sobre nós

Com operações em mais de 120 países, oferecemos melhores soluções para nossos clientes e oportunidades mais ricas para nosso pessoal. Como parceiro líder do setor de energia, estamos comprometidos em atingir zero emissões líquidas de carbono até 2050 e estamos sempre procurando as pessoas certas para nos ajudar a chegar lá. Pessoas que são tão apaixonadas quanto nós por tornar a energia mais segura, mais limpa e mais eficiente.

Junte-se a nós

Você está procurando uma oportunidade de fazer uma diferença real em uma empresa com alcance global e serviços e clientes interessantes? Junte-se a nós e cresça com uma equipe de pessoas que irão energizar e inspirar você!

A Baker Hughes Company prioriza oportunidades iguais para todos os candidatos. Todas as nossas vagas são destinadas também a pessoas portadoras de deficiência. As decisões de contratação são tomadas independentemente de raça, cor, religião, origem nacional ou étnica, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, deficiência, ou outras características protegidas por lei.

Na Mar Brasil, não apenas realizamos a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos de ar-condicionado, mas também proporcionamos qualidade de vida em diversas unidades de ensino espalhadas pelo país.

Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Instalação, Manutenção Preventiva e Corretiva : Verificação geral do funcionamento dos aparelhos, limpeza de componentes e substituição de peças conforme necessário.

  • Profissionais com profundo conhecimento em potência e ciclo frigorífico.

  • Certificação comprovada, veículo próprio, ferramental adequado e EPIs.

O que Oferecemos:

  • Contrato Estável : Oferecemos contratos de longa duração, garantindo estabilidade durante todas as estações do ano, tanto no inverno quanto no verão.
  • Política de Incentivo : Após o período de integração, o prestador pode contar com o financiamento de equipamentos, ferramentas e veículos.
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Dinâmico : Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional em atividades B2G, B2B e B2C.
  • Bônus e Premiação Extraordinária : Prestadores que cumprirem com suas obrigações contratuais, metas qualitativas e quantitativas, e demais políticas da empresa, poderão se qualificar para o programa de bonificação por produtividade e resultados.

Se você está pronto para se unir a uma empresa que valoriza a excelência e busca sempre as melhores soluções para seus clientes, esta é a sua chance. Junte-se a nós na Mar Brasil!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer FTE PT
description:
Welcome to Islands, where innovation meets execution, and bold ideas are turned into world-class products. We’re not your typical tech company—we’re a Product and Venture Studio that works with startups, scale-ups, and also seeds our own SaaS ventures. In just 18 months, we’ve scaled rapidly, building revolutionary software that solves real-world problems across industries. Our global team of 35+ brilliant minds spans Canada and Brazil, and we’re expanding fast. We’re looking for someone like you to help lead the charge.

Our culture is simple:

  • Break the rules — be bold, experiment, and push beyond expectations.
  • Embrace imperfection — progress trumps perfection in everything we do.
  • Have fun along the way — whether it's product sprints or team retreats in exotic locations like Bali or Florianopolis.

Position Overview

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of Islands’ technical innovation, architecting and refining cloud infrastructure to support our groundbreaking products—both client-facing and internal. You’ll design and scale microservice-based architectures, work hands-on with AWS, and ensure our CI/CD pipelines are robust. This role is flexible, suitable for full-time or part-time candidates.

We’re offering an opportunity to redefine how the future works, collaborating with a team that embraces experimentation and innovation at every turn.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, highly-available cloud infrastructure using AWS and microservices architecture.
  • Collaborate with developers to manage cloud resources for core projects, including Frameflow, our AI-powered QA Engineer.
  • Lead CI/CD pipeline development, ensuring seamless continuous deployment.
  • Oversee infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and modern tools.
  • Optimize for performance, security, and scalability as products expand into new markets.
  • Experiment with the latest DevOps technologies to continually improve infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of DevOps experience with hands-on cloud architecture in AWS.
  • Proficiency with microservices, containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Expertise with CI/CD pipelines and automation, including scalable IaaC with Terraform or similar.
  • Experience with version control (Git, Mercurial, SVN), reverse proxies, gRPC, K8s, Github Actions.
  • Familiarity with our tech stack and experience as a developer in React, Node.js, Typescript, or Python for Machine Learning.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset.
  • Experience with AWS and GCP.

Why Islands?

  • Unlimited vacation — work-life balance is essential for creativity and growth.
  • Micro-promotions — continuous growth through small, frequent promotions.
  • Annual retreats to Bali, Florianopolis, and other island locations.
  • Cutting-edge projects — working on products pushing the boundaries of software development and AI.
  • Culture of innovation — we break things fast, fix them faster, and love to experiment. We work hard and have fun.

If you’re ready to join a team building the future of tech and reshaping industries with AI-powered QA solutions, we’d love to meet you.

Você terá a chance de participar de um desafio extremamente motivante, ao lado de um time de alta performance e com um produto com capacidade de transformar positivamente muitas vidas.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Promover Dupixent (dupilumabe) através de visitas a profissionais de saúde.

title: Analista Comercial - E-commerce
description:
Somos o Grupo Webcontinental, a Sua Melhor Escolha!

A Webcontinental foi fundada em 2007 com o objetivo de transformar a vida das pessoas. O Grupo atua como e-commerce, marketplace, e possui a sua indústria própria através de duas verticais - Gallant Importação e Gallant Indústria.

Ao longo dos 16 anos de atuação no mercado, a Webcontinental ampliou suas áreas de atuação para diferentes segmentos, e conta com uma moderna estrutura física e uma logística eficiente, permitindo sua atuação em todo o território nacional.

A sede administrativa está localizada em Porto Alegre - RS, além dos três centros de distribuição (Viana - ES, Cariacica - ES e Navegantes - SC), e um escritório em São Paulo.

COMPROMISSO E CERTIFICAÇÃO:

A Webcontinental possui diversas certificações fundamentais para a construção de credibilidade no e-commerce, como o selo Ebit, que reafirma o compromisso ético da empresa em levar segurança ao processo de compra.

Além disso, algumas premiações coroaram a Web como empresa consolidada no meio, como o Prêmio ABComm de Inovação Digital 2024, que pela segunda vez consecutiva elegeu a Webcontinental como Melhor Marketplace do Brasil.

São 4 mil sellers cadastrados na Webcontinental Marketplace, que contam com um catálogo de 40 categorias, totalizando mais de 4 milhões de produtos cadastrados, vendidos através do site e de aplicativo próprio.

A missão da Webcontinental é proporcionar aos clientes um serviço de qualidade e agilidade, simplificando suas vidas.

Descrição da Vaga: Analista Comercial de Categoria

Como Analista Comercial de Categoria, você fará parte do time com um profundo conhecimento do mercado e das dinâmicas do setor e, principalmente, das categorias em que atua. Este profissional será responsável por:

  1. Analisar dados de venda do mercado e do nosso canal.
  2. Planejar e executar estratégias para potencializar e desenvolver os resultados por categoria dentro do site, garantindo o atingimento de metas de GMV e margem estabelecidas pela gestão.
  3. Atuar estrategicamente na negociação direta com os Sellers parceiros, elaborando campanhas comerciais e controlando a precificação.
  4. Selecionar e gerenciar os produtos das suas respectivas categorias que serão destacados em nosso site.
  5. Criar a curva ABC das categorias, identificando potenciais e oportunidades.
  6. Negociar Mix de produtos por categoria com a equipe interna de sellers, buscando melhor competitividade e rentabilidade para o e-commerce.

As Policlínicas são unidades especializadas de apoio diagnóstico, com serviços de consultas clínicas com médicos de diferentes especialidades, que são definidas com base no perfil epidemiológico da população de cada região. Visam ampliar o acesso ambulatorial às diversas especialidades médicas. Oferecem exames gráficos e de imagem com fins diagnósticos e, em alguns casos, realizam pequenos procedimentos. Isso garante mais resolutividade nos cuidados básicos com a saúde, e evita que pacientes precisem se dirigir aos hospitais com casos que podem ser solucionados ambulatoriamente.


Main responsibilities

Compreender as tarefas destinadas a exames médicos, emissão de diagnósticos, prescrição de medicamentos e outras formas de tratamento para diversos tipos de enfermidade, aplicando recursos de medicina preventiva ou terapêutica, para promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Exposição habitual e permanente, não ocasional e nem intermitente, ao risco biológico (Vírus e Bactérias)


Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina.

Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Angiologia.

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Angiologista.

  1. Auxiliar na criação e no acompanhamento de programas de capacitação: Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de programas de treinamento para os colaboradores, bem como acompanhar o progresso e resultados desses programas.
  2. Cuidar dos dados, da atualização de processos e uso efetivo das tecnologias de RH: Garantir a integridade e confidencialidade dos dados de RH, atualizar e otimizar os processos relacionados a RH e fazer uso efetivo das tecnologias e ferramentas disponíveis na área de RH.

Isso inclui a promoção de atividades que fortaleçam a cultura organizacional, incentivem o engajamento dos colaboradores e comuniquem eficazmente os valores, missão e objetivos da OUTMarketing.
  5. Apoiar e acompanhar processos de recrutamento e seleção end-to-end (desde a triagem, entrevistas, testes, processos admissionais): Realizar todas as etapas do processo de recrutamento e seleção, desde a triagem inicial de candidatos até o apoio na condução de entrevistas, testes de seleção e processos de admissão de novos colaboradores.

  7. Evolução na aplicação do código de conduta, ética e cultura organizacional: Garantir que o código de conduta, ética e cultura organizacional da OUTMarketing sejam compreendidos e aplicados pelos colaboradores. Acompanhar a evolução no cumprimento desses princípios.
  8. Manter arquivos atualizados no SharePoint de cada colaborador: Organizar e manter os arquivos e documentos dos colaboradores atualizados em um sistema de gerenciamento, como o SharePoint, garantindo fácil acesso e atualização dos registros.
  9. Manutenção de relacionamento com fornecedores: Gerenciar o relacionamento com fornecedores de serviços relacionados a RH, como empresas de recrutamento, fornecedores de treinamento e benefícios, garantindo que as necessidades da empresa sejam atendidas de maneira eficaz.

  12. Produção e apresentação de relatórios: Criar relatórios detalhados de desempenho e apresentá-los à equipe e ao cliente.
  13. Apoiar ações de desenvolvimento pessoal, planos de carreira, avaliações de desempenho, pesquisa de clima organizacional e processos de feedback: Gerenciar e monitorar iniciativas de desenvolvimento pessoal, planos de carreira, avaliações de desempenho, pesquisa de clima organizacional e processos de feedback para promover o crescimento e engajamento dos colaboradores.
  14. Ser multiplicador dos processos e valores culturais da OUTMarketing: Promover ativamente os valores culturais da empresa e servir como modelo a ser seguido pelos colaboradores.
  15. Acompanhar informações relevantes da convenção coletiva com o DP da Contabilidade ou Analista Pleno.

Graduação em Recursos Humanos, Administração ou área relacionada.

CURSOS E FORMAÇÃO COMPLEMENTAR

description:
Job description

Você é um advogado ou advogada que enxerga o Direito como ferramenta estratégica para viabilizar negócios, proteger relações e fortalecer a confiança institucional? Tem interesse em atuar em uma empresa de tecnologia com um grande propósito social, enfrentando desafios jurídicos complexos com autonomia, visão de parceria e foco em soluções eficazes? Então essa vaga pode ser o seu próximo passo.

Na Gabriel, o jurídico está no centro da construção de uma estrutura sólida, escalável e alinhada com os valores da empresa. Nosso time jurídico atua de forma transversal: está presente em negociações comerciais estratégicas, na modelagem de novos produtos, no desenho de políticas internas, na análise de riscos financeiros e trabalhistas, na governança de dados e propriedade intelectual, e também na jornada do cliente. E tudo isso com profundidade técnica, clareza de comunicação e muita colaboração com outras áreas.

Buscamos um Advogado Pleno que vá além da interpretação da norma — alguém que compreenda o contexto do negócio, que se relacione com diferentes times, que saiba equilibrar riscos e oportunidades e que tenha sensibilidade para temas críticos e decisões institucionais relevantes.

Mais do que lidar com documentos, você lidará com decisões. Decisões que impactam nossos parceiros, nossos clientes e o futuro da segurança no Brasil. Por isso, esperamos que você atue com empatia, responsabilidade e excelência.

Se você quer trabalhar em um ambiente desafiador, ao lado de pessoas comprometidas com propósito, impacto e inovação — e vê no Direito um caminho para transformar a realidade —, a Gabriel pode ser o lugar certo para você crescer.


Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos estratégicos com foco em segurança jurídica e equilíbrio comercial; participar ativamente de negociações propondo soluções jurídicas aderentes ao risco e objetivo do negócio;
  • Padronizar modelos contratuais e repositórios documentais para garantir agilidade e escalabilidade; atuar como parceiro jurídico de áreas como produto, comercial e operações em soluções e modelos comerciais complexos;
  • Sustentar juridicamente decisões comerciais e posicionamentos institucionais em disputas contratuais;
  • Apoiar a área financeira na análise de riscos legais e na estruturação de modelos de faturamento, precificação e cobrança;
  • Validar cláusulas financeiras e obrigações legais tributárias, fiscais e contábeis; contribuir em discussões sobre impactos legais de estratégias financeiras e participar de auditorias;
  • Assessorar o time de gente e gestão na administração de riscos trabalhistas, incluindo reestruturações e remuneração variável; revisar políticas internas, códigos de conduta e programas de compliance;
  • Atuar na interlocução com escritórios externos, elaborar pareceres técnicos e apoiar em fiscalizações e due diligences trabalhistas;
  • Garantir juridicidade e clareza nas comunicações com clientes; revisar termos de uso, políticas de privacidade e manifestações em canais como SAC, Ouvidoria e plataformas públicas;
  • Padronizar roteiros de atendimento com embasamento jurídico; apoiar na gestão de incidentes críticos e na definição de fluxos e jornadas sob perspectiva de risco jurídico;
  • Apoiar na proteção de ativos de PI (marcas, patentes, softwares, direitos autorais); revisar contratos de licenciamento e cessão; monitorar uso de marcas e gerenciar registros e defesas de PI.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Sólido conhecimento jurídico nas áreas contratual, cível, trabalhista, propriedade intelectual e direito aplicado à atividade empresarial;
  • Visão de parceria com o negócio, atuando de forma próxima às áreas internas para viabilizar lançamentos de produtos, novos modelos comerciais e estratégias empresariais, sempre equilibrando segurança jurídica e inovação;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar e traduzir riscos legais em recomendações práticas para as áreas de negócios, finanças, operações, RH e experiência do cliente;
  • Foco em resultado e eficiência, buscando soluções ágeis e escaláveis, que simplifiquem processos e otimizem operações sem comprometer a segurança jurídica;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente no nosso escritório em Pinheiros.

Requirements and skills

Qualificações:

  • Inscrição ativa na OAB;
  • Experiência prévia na elaboração, revisão e negociação de contratos complexos, participando ativamente de negociações comerciais e estruturando soluções jurídicas alinhadas ao perfil de risco da empresa;
  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação, adaptando o discurso para públicos diversos (jurídico e não jurídico), especialmente na produção de contratos, pareceres, políticas internas e materiais de suporte ao atendimento ao cliente;
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade para gerir suas demandas com organização, priorização e foco em soluções práticas, sem abrir mão da excelência técnica;
  • Compromisso com ética, transparência e conformidade, atuando como guardião dos princípios jurídicos e reputacionais da empresa.

Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação em Direito Digital, com foco em regulação de plataformas, privacidade e novas tecnologias;
  • Atuação em empresas de tecnologia, inovação ou serviços digitais, com exposição a temas como modelos de assinatura, SaaS, plataformas, marketplaces ou dados pessoais;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão jurídica, automação contratual, repositórios digitais e fluxos de assinatura eletrônica;
  • Inglês jurídico avançado, com autonomia para revisar contratos internacionais e participar de reuniões ou negociações em inglês.

Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. That’s why we built the most complete cloud analytics and data platform for AI. The world’s top companies across every major industry trust Teradata to improve business performance, enrich customer experiences, and fully integrate data across the enterprise.

What You’ll Do

The Senior Data Scientist (pre-sales) is an experienced and expert Data Scientist, able to provide industry thought-leadership on Analytics and its application across industries and use-cases. The Senior Data Scientist supports the account team in framing business problems and in identifying analytic solutions that leverage Teradata technology and that are disruptive, innovative - and above all, practical. An articulate and compelling communicator, the Senior Data Scientist establishes our position as an important partner for advanced analytics with customers and prospects and is a trusted advisor to executives, senior managers and fellow data scientists alike across a range of target accounts. They are also a hands-on practitioner who is ready, willing and able to roll-up their sleeves and to deliver POC and short-term pre-sales engagements. The Senior Data Scientist has an excellent theoretical and practical understanding of statistics and machine learning and has a strong track record of applying this understanding at scale to drive business benefit. They are insanely curious and a natural problem-solver, able to effectively promote Teradata technology and solutions to our customers.

Who You’ll Work With

The successful candidate will work with other expert team members to:

  1. Provide pre-sales support at an executive level to the Teradata account teams, helping them to position and sell complex Analytic solutions that drive sales of Teradata software.
  2. Provide strategic pre-sales consulting to executives and senior managers in our target market.
  3. Support the delivery of PoC and PoV projects that demonstrate the viability and applicability of Analytic use-cases and the superiority of Teradata solutions and services.
  4. Work with the extended Account team, and Sales Analytics Specialists to develop new Analytic propositions that are aligned with industry trends and customer requirements.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  1. A degree level qualification (preferably Masters or PhD) in Statistics, Data Science, the physical or biological sciences or a related discipline.
  2. Proven hands-on experience of complex analytics at scale, for example in the areas of IoT and sensor data.
  3. Understanding of the PMML and ONNX model portability standards.
  4. Experience with Teradata partner’s analytical products, Cloud Service providers such as AzureML and Sagemaker, and partner products such as Dataiku and H2O.
  5. Strong hands-on programming skills in at least one major analytic programming language and/or tool in addition to SQL.

What You’ll Bring

  1. Expertise in Data Science with a strong theoretical grounding in statistics, advanced analytics, and machine learning, and at least 5 years of real-world experience in the application of advanced analytics.
  2. A passion for knowledge sharing and a commitment to continuous professional development.
  3. A belief in Teradata's Analytic solutions and services and a commitment to working with the product, engineering, and consulting teams to ensure that they continue to lead the market.
  4. An ability to turn complex technical subject matter into relatable, easy-to-digest content for senior audiences.

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Sales Account Manager, Amazon
description:
Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of advertising solutions. We partner with advertisers to reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com.br, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high quality sites across the web, and devices. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing organization working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.


We’re looking for a results oriented Sales Account Manager who is passionate about partnering with our advertisers, educating them and helping to solve ambiguous business problems, mitigating risks before they become roadblocks. As a Sales Account Manager, you manage and deliver against complex advertiser goals and problems to drive revenue and achieve revenue targets. You nurture customer relationships and create revenue opportunities from the advertisers you own. You’ll not only dive deep into data to understand trends, but also communicate the “why” behind results and make actionable recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Additionally, you’ll be able to leverage Amazon’s proprietary data to provide strategic and personalized recommendations, influencing both your internal team and your external customer to facilitate them reaching their business goals. The Sales Account Manager’s strategic digital expertise and influence is considered critical to unlocking greater value and impact for our advertisers.

  1. Become a knowledgeable partner and leader on Amazon Advertising solutions
  2. Deliver the highest level of sales and customer service to our clients.

  6. Develop campaign strategies and audience engagement recommendations

  8. Perform in-depth data analysis to form and deliver actionable recommendations for both short- and long-term advertising strategy
  9. Educate advertisers on performance metrics, insights, and how to drive greater results
  10. Work cross-functionally with Senior Sales and other Amazon partners to drive incremental revenue and increase advertiser satisfaction

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Bachelors’ degree in Economics, Marketing, Advertising, Statistics, Engineering or Business
  2. 4+ years relevant experience in a client facing role including but not limited to digital marketing, analytics etc.

Please apply with resume in English

  1. Experience in Omni-channel marketing, display, or search marketing

  3. Excellent organizational, relationship-building, and communication (written and verbal) skills
  4. Programmatic strategy and implementation experience
  5. Proven track record of delivering results (including revenue targets) and significantly contributing to advertiser revenue growth

title: Communications Lead, Brazil
description:
In this role, you will lead all communications, internal and external, for Spotify in Brazil. This includes managing all corporate, consumer & brand, content, advertising, and internal communications across the market.

This diverse role requires a motivated and independent self-starter, who is prepared to work independently across a wide variety of tasks and at all levels.

You should be familiar with the media and influencer landscape in Brazil, the market’s culture, Spotify’s business priorities and objectives, and how to create understanding and connectivity with the rest of the company. Above all, your work will impact the way Brazil understands and learns about Spotify. You will report directly to Spotify’s Director of Communications in Latin America.


What You'll Do
  • Corporate Communications: lead all communications activities in Brazil on behalf of Spotify and its senior executives and their activities.
  • Consumer Communications: set local strategy and implement communications campaigns across all channels.
  • Crisis Communications: The position involves coordinating and leading all aspects of short-term reactive communications for the market. It demands skills to assess the situation, build a plan, and act swiftly to get collaborator agreement, including developing reactive statements and key messages.
  • Music and Podcast Industry Communications: Communicate Spotify’s value to the creator audience and our work to connect artists, creators, and fans.
  • Trade Communications: Build Spotify’s profile as a leading advertising platform to brand and marketing trade audiences.
  • Manage PR agency support in Brazil: provide the brief and direction to the agency.
  • Develop strong connections with traditional and new media, along with influencers, for effective communication.
  • Internal Communications: set local strategy and lead internal communications activities in Brazil.
  • Partner collaboration: Collaborate and secure agreement from senior-level collaborators at the highest level across the business, including the Brazil management team and regional partners.
Who You Are
  • 10+ years of relevant communications experience in Consumer PR, digital, media, entertainment, and music industry PR, or in the tech industry.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
  • Demonstrated capability in developing and implementing strategic PR campaigns.
  • Motivated self-starter with a hands-on attitude.
  • Proficient in narrative, storytelling, communications channels, and writing for a variety of audiences.
  • Ability to multitask and work in a hectic and extremely fast-paced industry and environment without sacrificing attention to detail.
  • Collaborative individual who enjoys partnering closely across teams and functions to build and distribute the most impactful communications possible.
  • Strong project management and agency management skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Of course, an ever-enthusiastic and passionate representative of the Spotify brand. :)
Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come to the office at least 2 to 3 times per week.

Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

Team Overview

The Financial Institution Business Development (FIBD) team focused on payments plays a critical role in shaping and managing strategic partnerships with banks, payment providers, and other financial stakeholders. Our mission is to enhance the company’s payment capabilities, ensuring a seamless, secure, and efficient transaction experience for our customers across multiple business units, including ride-hailing and 99Pay.

As part of the online payments vertical, we work closely with acquirers, issuers, card schemes, and alternative payment providers to optimize payment operations, expand local payment acceptance, reduce costs, and drive innovation. Collaboration with internal stakeholders—such as risk, compliance, legal, treasury, and product teams—is key to ensuring regulatory compliance and continuous improvement of our payment ecosystem.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the rapidly evolving payments landscape, working on high-impact projects that drive financial efficiency and enhance the user experience.

Role Responsibilities

  1. Monitoring and ensuring the seamless operation of payment methods, including cards, PIX, and alternative payment solutions.
  2. Analyzing payment data and trends to identify inefficiencies, propose improvements, and enhance user experience.
  3. Managing relationships with payment service providers, acquirers, banks, and card schemes to ensure operational excellence.
  4. Collaborating with risk, IT, compliance, legal, and treasury teams to streamline workflows and mitigate payment-related risks.
  5. Ensuring regulatory compliance, staying up to date with payment industry standards and local regulations.
  6. Supporting payment-related projects, including the integration of new payment methods and technology enhancements.

Role Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  2. At least 2 years of experience in payments, fintech, financial operations, or related fields.
  3. A strong analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data and propose actionable insights.
  4. Excellent communication skills, both with internal teams and external partners (proficiency in English is mandatory).
  5. A flexible and proactive attitude, comfortable working across time zones, especially in Brazil and China.
  6. A keen interest in learning and growing in the payments industry, rather than relying solely on prior experience. This is a hands-on role with significant learning opportunities.

If you are passionate about payments and excited about making an impact in a global tech company, we’d love to hear from you!

EEO Statement

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

Mercado Financeiro – Diretor financeiro – Mutant – São Paulo

Estamos em busca de um Diretor Financeiro com visão estratégica e forte orientação para resultados, capaz de liderar e transformar nossa agenda financeira em uma vantagem competitiva.

*Sua missão*

Como Diretor Financeiro, você será o guardião da saúde financeira da Mutant, com papel central na condução de iniciativas que impulsionem eficiência, crescimento sustentável e geração de valor. Sua atuação será marcada por uma abordagem consultiva, conectando finanças ao coração dos negócios.

*Principais desafios e responsabilidades*

– Monitorar e consolidar o desempenho financeiro, garantindo aderência às metas estratégicas e apresentando insights acionáveis;

– Estruturar e liderar projetos para otimização de despesas, assegurando equilíbrio entre eficiência e qualidade operacional;

– Desenvolver projeções robustas e cenários financeiros estratégicos, alinhados ao roadmap de crescimento da Mutant;

– Identificar drivers de crescimento e oportunidades de alavancagem financeira, contribuindo para decisões baseadas em dados;

– Colaborar diretamente com lideranças das áreas para traduzir estratégias corporativas em ações financeiras concretas;

– Garantir aderência a normas, padrões e melhores práticas de gestão financeira e contábil.

– Formação superior em áreas como Administração, Economia ou Engenharia, com pós-graduação/MBA em Finanças ou áreas correlatas;

– Sólida experiência em posições de liderança no âmbito financeiro em empresas de serviços, com histórico de entrega em ambientes de alta complexidade;

– Habilidade comprovada em conectar indicadores financeiros ao desempenho de negócios, com mindset orientado a resultados;

– Experiência em liderar times multifuncionais, com forte habilidade de comunicação e influência estratégica;

– Pensamento analítico e capacidade de atuar em cenários desafiadores, mantendo agilidade e foco em soluções;

– Expertise em metodologias de planejamento financeiro e sistemas de controle (ERP, BI).

A pós-graduação em prepara você para ocupar essa posição!
